---

```{r}
# =========================
# Dinucleotide % per group — grouped bar plot
# =========================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# ---- custom colors (same palette) ----
custom_colors <- c(
  "M_H_C_H" = "#F28C9D",
  "M_L_C_H" = "#F3E065",
  "M_H_C_L" = "#65C9F3C9",
  "M_L_C_L" = "#9EAAE0"
)

# ---- 1) Read input file ----
df <- read.delim(
  "02.Dinucleotide_percentage_4groups.tsv",
  header = TRUE,
  sep = "\t",
  check.names = FALSE
)

# ---- 2) Long format ----
dinuc_order <- c(
  "TT","TC","CT","CC",
  "TG","TA","CG","CA",
  "GT","GC","AT","AC",
  "GG","GA","AG","AA"
)

df_long <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -Dinucleotide,
    names_to = "group",
    values_to = "Percent"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    group = factor(group, levels = names(custom_colors)),
    Dinucleotide = factor(Dinucleotide, levels = dinuc_order)
  )

# ---- 3) Y-axis scale ----
# Your input values are already percentages, e.g. 9.89 = 9.89%
y_scale <- scale_y_continuous(
  limits = c(0, max(df_long$Percent) * 1.15)
)

# ---- 4) Grouped bar plot ----
p <- ggplot(
  df_long,
  aes(
    x = Dinucleotide,
    y = Percent,
    fill = group
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 0.001
  ) +
  y_scale +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = custom_colors,
    name = "Group"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Dinucleotide Average Percentage per Cluster by Group",
    x = "Dinucleotide",
    y = "Average Percentage (%)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    )
  )

print(p)
```

```{r}
# ============================
# Faceted view
# ============================

p_facets <- ggplot(
  df_long,
  aes(
    x = Dinucleotide,
    y = Percent,
    fill = group
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    color = "black",
    width = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ group,
    ncol = 2
  ) +
  y_scale +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = custom_colors,
    guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Dinucleotide Average Percentage per Cluster",
    x = "Dinucleotide",
    y = "Average Percentage (%)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    panel.border = element_rect(
      color = "black",
      fill = NA,
      linewidth = 1
    )
  )

print(p_facets)
```
